text_en:
Back to Basics · R-0 Class Documentation Aid

Issuing Department: Records & Behavioral Archives Division
Issued To: Employees cleared for independent output assessment following voluntary skills inventory liquidation

This tool is issued to employees whose training authorizations have been fully surrendered in exchange for accelerated output recognition. It does not replace a skills portfolio. It is the acknowledgment that one no longer has a skills portfolio.

Operating Notes:
—— Forty-one employees who received this item subsequently submitted inquiry forms regarding re-authorization of lapsed skill certifications. The inquiry form referenced (RM-114) has been on administrative hold since the previous fiscal quarter. Records & Behavioral Archives has logged all forty-one submissions.
—— Holders have reported that the item feels lighter than its dimensions suggest, and noticeably less so by the final week of the evaluation cycle. Physical Properties Review has declined to comment in writing.
—— Several holders have noted that the absence of supplementary tools produces a period of approximately two to four working days during which output volume initially drops before stabilizing. Stabilization has been confirmed in the majority of documented cases. The minority has not been separately categorized.
—— Upon reassignment or voluntary departure, this item is to be returned to the Records & Behavioral Archives Division together with any outstanding output logs. Replacement issuance requires approval from the Compliance Review Committee and is not guaranteed within the same cycle.

This item has not been cleared for use in conjunction with any active skill authorization. Employees currently holding open training credits should consult HR Policy Coordination before acceptance.
